rule_of_this_file: Frozen before any detector training run (including speed probes). Amendments are appended to 'amendments' with their UTC time and reason, before the score they could affect is computed; no field above them is rewritten.
owner_steering: 2026-10-17 21:16Z: we need it to run on a ps vita, so smaller == better; play around with sizings.

finders.refine: GRAD then runtime/vocr_lines_refine.c with VOCR_REFINE_DEFAULT = 0x1F (twin synth/lines_refine.py)
finders.det: a detector candidate: the int8 blob through runtime/vocr_textdet.c (C) and synth/textdet_twin.py (its bit-exact Python twin); every development region is run through both and must agree box for box, or the candidate is ineligible

wd.what: VOCR5's development whole dialogue (eval/vocr5_select.load_wd): finder-tighten's tv_dlg and dn_dlg regions of the reserved.json dev_sample VNs, tv_dlg plus the dn_dlg frames tv_dlg does not hold, base / +4 / +8 px; every crop a finder returns (vertical-flagged boxes excepted) is read by the VOCR5 model in W8I through the C runtime with VOCR_INVERT from the box's dark flag, joined in the finder's order and scored by transcript_score (all/full): dialogue CER, the regions hold no speaker name
wd.bootstrap: VN clusters, 10,000 resamples, numpy default_rng(0), sorted VN ids, linear 2.5/97.5 percentiles (eval/textdet.vn_diff; one pair = eval/vocr3_report.cluster_bootstrap)

native_vita.what: the CLANNAD-dev-style subset: the wd units whose frame is a native PS Vita screenshot (teacher_val frames whose teacher read is of kind 'vita', devnative's Vita frames): 960x544 native Vita text, where finder-tighten's refinement was level on development and worse on CLANNAD (docs/finder-tighten.md)

empty.what: eval/linefind's 'empty' regions (text-free regions from the upper screen) of vita_dev and psp_dev, regions of a reserved test VN left out (vita_dev v36, psp_dev v1267 / v4060): 66 regions; empty rate = the share for which the finder returns no line

development.linefind: line recall / precision / F1 (IoU >= 0.5), region exact, merged / split / cut per set and tag on vita_dev, psp_dev (development) and vita_holdout, psp_holdout (report only); never research_a/b
report_only: the owner's CHAOS;CHILD (v14018) native Vita whole dialogue (finder-tighten's own_dlg Vita units): the detector never trains on v14018, the VOCR5 models did (in-sample for the recognizers), so it is a secondary native-Vita check that decides nothing
the dn pairs of the dev_sample VNs: the detector's box for the line against the hand-cut ink crop
gate arms: GRAD and GRAD + refine with every line dropped when the detector returns no text for the region (an empty-region gate in front of the hand-written finder)

baseline.note: the wd units equal VOCR5's stored selection units for the three selected runs, unit for unit

detector.family: train/textdet_model.py: a stem (3x3/2), a downsampling stage to output stride 4 or 8, 3-5 blocks (separable: 3x3 depthwise with dilation + 1x1; or plain 3x3 with dilation) and a 1x1 head with 4 maps per cell: K (text kernel), O (vertical), A1 / A2 (distances to the line's near and far edges across the line). BatchNorm folded; int8 weights, int8 activations, int32 accumulators, fixed-point requantisation: integer arithmetic only

targets.box: a line's main-text ink box (fill, outline and shadow; furigana, emphasis dots, cursors and icons excluded) on its long axis and across it
targets.kernel: cells whose centre lies within max(h/4, s/2) of the line's centre line across it (h = ink size across the line, s = stride) and whose span meets the ink box along it
targets.A1_A2: for kernel cells, the distances in px from the cell centre to the ink box's near and far edges across the line (int8 code = 2 x px, clamped to 0..127)
targets.O: 1 on the kernel cells of vertical lines, 0 on horizontal ones (loss on kernel cells only)
targets.ignore: areas the generator marks unlabelled (unknown or unreadable text) carry no loss

decode.drop: components of fewer than 2 cells (stride 4) or 1 cell (stride 8); boxes under 4 px across
decode.orientation: vertical iff the sum of the component's O codes is > 0
decode.across: with c2 = 2 x a cell's centre across the line (2*s*i + s - 1) and n cells: near edge = floor(sum(c2 - A1) / (2n)), far edge = ceil(sum(c2 + A2) / (2n)), integers only
decode.along: the component's first cell x stride to (last cell + 1) x stride
decode.pad: max(2, (h * 18 + 50) / 100) px on every side (h = far - near), then clipped to the region
decode.order: horizontal lines top to bottom (a line whose rows overlap the previous one's by half the smaller height goes left to right), then vertical lines right to left
decode.cap: 16 lines (VocrLineSet), the rest dropped and truncated set
decode.dark: vocr_line_dark on the padded box (the GRAD finder's polarity rule, unchanged)
decode.vertical_boxes: flagged, never handed to the horizontal recognizers (not read in wd, protected or CLANNAD scoring)

detector.constants_rule: the decode constants above are fixed here; they may change only by an amendment made before any candidate's wd score exists

sweep.seeds: seed 1 for every shape, seed 2 for s4_c4, s4_c8, s4_c16, s8_c8, s8_c16, s8_c32
sweep.outside_the_rule: an int4-weight study (fake-quantised 4-bit weights of 2-3 trained shapes, report only: the runtime runs int8) and the strip/row-buffer arena table (the runtime streams rows exactly, so a strip height changes no output)
sweep.shared_trunk: considered and not swept: the recognizers read 32-px line crops resized after detection, so no layer of theirs can run on the region before the lines are known

training.where: train/textdet_train.py through HEAVY_SLOTS=12 $HERD/heavy.sh, 5 torch threads per run
training.optimizer: AdamW, lr 4e-3, 500 warm-up steps, cosine to 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4 (not on BN / bias)
training.loss: K: BCE + dice over valid cells; O: BCE on kernel cells x 0.5; A1/A2: smooth L1 on kernel cells (px / 8)
training.qat: int8 fake quantisation (weights per output channel, activations per tensor) from step 24,000
training.selection_inside_a_run: none: the last step is the run's model (no checkpoint is picked on any score)

data.generator: synth/textdet_data.py: pinned shards (sha256 manifest committed before the first training run) of grey canvases with line boxes (main-text ink box, orientation, role) and ignore areas
data.synthetic: synth3 version 3's region renderer (its ink, fill and ruby masks give exact boxes) in canvases of several sizes (the region, loose crops, whole screens on text-free backgrounds), plus vertical-text renders and empty negatives (boxes, scenes and screens with no text)
data.real: MeikiOCR line boxes refined to ink and its detector boxes (with their vertical flag) from realplus, teacher, devnative (training part) and the owner's frames, cut into regions like a player's plus text-free regions
excluded: every reserved.json 'test' VN (vita-test, psp-test, CLANNAD family and their release partners) and 'dev_sample' VN, and every 'sessions' release
every screenshot of eval's sets (vita-test, psp-test), of eval/linefind's six manifests and every VN of vita_dev, vita_holdout, psp_dev, psp_holdout
every frame of the wd cohorts (by shot id) and of finder-tighten's own_dlg Vita units (the owner's CHAOS;CHILD v14018)
synthetic scenes and names: synth3's own exclusions (CLANNAD manifest, test VNs)
data.check: eval/tools/reserve_check.py on every real shard, recorded

promotion_rule.eligible: int8 blob < 100,000 B; arena at 960x544 <= 131,072 B (the C runtime's exact function); <= 30,000,000 MACs on a 900x150 region; C == twin on every development region
promotion_rule.size_order: blob bytes ascending, then MACs on a 900x150 region, then run name
promotion_rule.qualifies: for each of VOCR5-S, -N, -L: the wd CER difference det - GRAD and det - refine (points, all variants pooled) has a VN-cluster 95% interval entirely below 0; on the native_vita subset no such difference (det - GRAD, det - refine, any model) has an interval entirely above 0; and the development empty rate is >= 0.75
promotion_rule.winner: W = the smallest qualifying candidate; then repeatedly, among the qualifying candidates larger than W, the smallest whose mean over the three models of its wd CER difference to W has a VN-cluster interval entirely below 0 becomes W; the final W is selected
promotion_rule.no_winner: if no candidate qualifies the verdict is negative: GRAD (+ refine where the overlay uses it) stays, and the protected sets are read once for the eligible candidate with the lowest mean wd CER over the three models, labelled not promoted

fine_tune.trigger: no candidate qualifies, and an eligible candidate passes the native_vita and empty conditions with a wd CER below GRAD's and refine's (point estimates) for every model
fine_tune.recipe: for each tier, the released checkpoint fine-tuned 3,000 steps with VOCR5's arm F recipe, the GRAD-crop and refined-crop sources replaced by that candidate's crops of the same frames; then the rule re-applied with the fine-tuned models in every arm (GRAD, refine and det)

protected.when: once, after the selection (or the no-winner record) is committed and pushed; attempt records are created exclusively and refuse a second run
sets: vita-test + psp-test whole dialogue: eval's regions (an uncertain line leaves its region out), base / +4 / +8, GRAD, refine and det with VOCR5-S/N/L, body and all text, VN-cluster intervals
vita-test + psp-test detection: the same regions against eval's line boxes (line R / P / F1, region exact), GRAD, refine and det

CLANNAD long run (owner-drive-ingest's frozen references, refs_sha256 35411688...): each page's ROI; a reference line reads the finder lines whose rows lie mostly in its GRAD box (most of a line's height inside the box), joined in order; whole-page bootstraps; plus the number of lines returned on the pages and boxes the references hold no text for

estimates.label: every console time and memory figure is a host estimate until measured on a console
estimates.mac_rate: VOCR3-H15 ran 1564992 MACs per CTC frame at 5.0-5.2 ms on one A9 core (v0.8.0-test.1, 333 MHz assumed): 0.301-0.313 GMAC/s at 333 MHz, x444/333 at 444 MHz
estimates.cycle_model: vita/a9_cycles.py on the Vita compiler's code of runtime/vocr_textdet.c under plugin qemu-arm, with ocr-speed's calibration factor (x1.0007 of the high bound at 333 MHz)

amendments.before: any detector training run or score
amendments.reason: the code the protocol names was written after freezing; this records what it pins down
changes: train/textdet_model.py grew the training code (validity masks, BatchNorm folding, the fake-quantised QTextDet); its SHAPES and layers() are unchanged (every shape's MACs, parameters and receptive field equal the protocol's 'sweep' entries; tests/test_textdet.py checks it). Its docstring's sentence on the cell centre was wrong: the receptive field of cell i is centred on input pixel s*i; the targets and the decode measure from s*i + (s-1)/2 as frozen (a labelling convention the network learns; nothing changes)

the decode's exact specification is synth/textdet_twin.py (the bit-exact twin the C runtime must equal): 'boxes under 4 px across' means far - near < 4 before padding; a line whose clipped box is empty is dropped; A1 and A2 are used as the head writes them; at most 64 candidates are kept (the smallest by (vertical, y, x, h, w)) before the 16-line cap; the reading order's row rule compares a line with its row's first line (rows overlapping by at least half the smaller height) and orders a row by (x, y, h, w); vertical lines go by (-(x + w), y, x, w, h)

train/textdet_export.py is the int8 export: per-output-channel weight scales max|w|/127, int32 biases, fixed-point requantisation (multiplier in [2^30, 2^31), shift 1..62, round half up), input codes grey - 128, the head's K and O at 1/16 per code and A1, A2 at 1/2 px per code

amendments.before: any detector training run or score
amendments.reason: the data are rendered and pinned, the training script is written; this records what they fix
changes: the two head ablations s4_c8_ko and s8_c16_ko are dropped from the sweep: the frozen decode reads A1 and A2 for every box, so a head without edge maps has no defined box, and a second decode would be an unregistered change. The sweep is the other 16 shapes: 22 runs

data: data/manifests/textdet_shards_v1.json pins 117 shards (148,602 canvases, 394,949 lines, 53,332 of them vertical) by sha256: synthetic 120,000 (region 55,529, loose 24,779, vertical 15,537, empty 24,155), realplus 19,705, teacher 6,003, owner 2,821 (private), devnative 73; synth/textdet_data.py at the manifest's code_sha256. A positive's ink size across the line is 8-72 px (other lines are ignore areas); per-VN caps realplus 2, teacher 6, owner 80 screenshots; eval/tools/reserve_check.py --pixels on the four real sources: RESERVE_OK (no blocker; the owner rows are VN- and session-checked, 160 of 2,821 also by hash)

training (train/textdet_train.py): the real half of a batch is realplus 0.35, teacher 0.35, owner 0.25, devnative 0.05; a canvas that fits the 192 x 512 window is used whole, a bigger one gives a random window or (real canvases, half the time) a player-like region around a group of lines (union plus 4-20 px, +0/+4/+8 px, halved at the PSP target); one data-loader process beside the 5 torch threads; gradient norm clipped at 5; QAT activation scales from the 99.99th percentile of |output| over 32 batches
eval/textdet.py grew the detect / read / select commands; its linefind and baseline code is unchanged (the committed baseline re-computes identically, every field but its 'computed' time)

amendments.after: round 1's development scores (eval/textdet_round1_dev_20261018.json: no candidate qualifies) and before any score of round 2
amendments.reason: round 1 found no winner: its best candidates are resolved below GRAD but not below GRAD + refine. The development failure analysis (VOCR5-N, the round-1 report candidate) puts all of the excess over GRAD + refine in the units where the detector returns fewer lines than the reference: lines set close together (PSP-sized NVL pages, two-line boxes at about 1.1 line heights' pitch) merged into one box or missed, worst in the +4 / +8 px variants (the stride-8 grid's phase moves with the region); the units whose line count it gets right are about 590 errors better than GRAD + refine. A recognizer fine-tune cannot repair a box that holds two lines, while the refinement's SPLIT and TIGHTEN steps exist to split and trim such boxes
changes: round 1's fine-tune clause, which its scores trigger, is not run in round 1: it moves to the final round and runs there if its trigger holds for that round's candidates (a deviation from the letter of the protocol, recorded here)

round 2 (pre-registered here): the finder det+refine = the detector's horizontal lines (vertical ones left out, as before) handed to runtime/vocr_lines_refine.c with VOCR_REFINE_DEFAULT (its twin synth/lines_refine.py; both unchanged, sources_sha256 above), the caller's arena shared (arena = max of the detector's and the refinement's at 960 x 544, which must be <= 131,072 B). The candidates are the 22 round-1 blobs, unchanged. Everything else of the promotion rule is unchanged: the cohorts, the conditions against GRAD and GRAD + refine for VOCR5-S/N/L, the native_vita and empty-rate conditions, the eligibility (C == twin for the whole det+refine path), the size order and the winner rule
the empty rate of det+refine is the detector's: the refinement never adds a line to a region the detector returns none for (eval/textdet.py checks it on every development empty region)

if round 2 has no winner the verdict is negative, unless a further round is pre-registered before its training or scoring; the protected sets are read once, for the final round's selection (or its report candidate)

train/textdet_export.py changed after amendment 2's pin (520d759: --wbits, the report-only int4 study); its default int8 export is unchanged: all 22 runs' final.vtd re-export byte for byte from their final.pt with it
round 1's C == twin check and arenas used the runtime's early, bit-exact version (feat/textdet-runtime f9d4ad3); the final runtime is re-checked on every development case before the final selection

amendments.after: round 2's development scores (eval/textdet_round2_dev_20261018.json: no candidate qualifies) and before any round-3 training run
amendments.reason: round 2 brought the best candidate to within reach (det+refine minus GRAD + refine: upper interval bounds +0.39 / +0.35 / +0.08 points for VOCR5-S / N / L) but found no winner. The remaining excess sits in the +4 px variants and in PSP text set 14-18 px apart: with the inclusive 'within r' of the kernel rule, a line under 2s px tall whose centre falls on a cell boundary gets two kernel rows, so at stride 8 the kernel targets of lines 16 px apart touched in 36 of 320 such line pairs (h 12-15 px, pitch 14-18 px, every phase; 24 with a strict bound, where only pitches under 2s remain), and the network learnt to join them
changes: round 3 (the last round): kernel cells are those whose centre lies strictly within r = max(h/4, s/2) of the line's centre across it (the nearest cell when none): train/textdet_train.py --strict-kernel. The data (textdet_shards_v1), the rest of the recipe, the decode and the finder (det+refine, amendment 3) are unchanged

round 3's 12 runs ('runs'; seeds 3 and 4, new): seven round-1 shapes and five deeper ones ('shapes', with their exact costs and arenas; every det+refine arena at 960 x 544 <= 131,072 B and every 900 x 150 cost <= 30 M MACs)
the promotion rule is unchanged and applied to round 3's runs with det+refine

the fine-tune clause (moved to the final round by amendment 3) is withdrawn: rounds 1 and 2 locate the losses in box geometry (merged or missed lines), not in the recognizers' input distribution; the units whose line count the detector gets right already read better than GRAD + refine with the unchanged recognizers
round 3 is the last: without a winner the verdict is negative and the protected sets are read once for round 3's report candidate (det+refine), labelled not promoted; with one, for the winner
tests/test_textdet.py's protocol-table check covers this amendment's shapes
